content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Cantonment Board Barrackpore Radiologist Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: http://barrackpore.cantt.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 14-08-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Cantonment Board Barrackpore. This government organization is inviting applications for various posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment drive is Radiologist. Candidates with relevant qualifications are encouraged to apply.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Radiologist post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Radiologist post in the Cantonment Board Barrackpore recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for Cantonment Board Barrackpore Radiologist recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Cantonment Board Barrackpore Radiologist recruitment is Offline. Candidates need to send their application form to the specified address.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to apply for the Radiologist post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Radiologist post is 14 August 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for the Radiologist position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Radiologist position will receive a salary of Rs. 3000 Per Day, as per the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What are the essential qualifications for the Radiologist post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have an MBBS Degree, a Post Graduate Degree/Diploma/DNB in Radiology from an MCI-recognised Institution, completed a one-year rotating internship, and have valid registration with the West Bengal Medical Council or National Medical Council.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this Cantonment Board Barrackpore Radiologist recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for Radiologist recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Radiologist post includes a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification. Candidates should prepare accordingly.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply?
faq.answer: You can find the official notification PDF and details on how to apply in the "Important Links" section of this article, or by visiting the official website barrackpore.cantt.gov.in.
